title: bank of america / 8 k / earnings | BANK OF AMERICA CORP /DE/ 8-K Filing — 2026-04-15
summary: Bank of America filed its 8-K current report on April 15, 2026, disclosing Q1 2026 financial results: net income of $8.6 billion and diluted EPS of $1.11. The filing also announces an investor conference call and provides a comprehensive list of registered securities on NYSE.
